shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击：用暖金光晕下的成列主食罐阵建立高端足量印象，纯图无字合规。
主图一秒法则：用盛盘肉汁肉块的光泽质感一眼说清适口性这一首要购买理由。
shots.textZone: top quarter centred display headline slot, one thin double-arc badge outline at the right

shots.intent: 让买家代入：真实居家光线里挑食的猫主动走来，把主粮与日常喂养时刻绑定。
shots.textZone: lower third headline band plus one empty thin-line seal outline at the left

shots.intent: 解释机制：以微距证明肉块真实质地与肉汁包裹，把适口性主张落到可见证据。
shots.textZone: narrow clear band along the top edge for one display headline

shots.intent: 消除信息疑虑：用两块空白参数板与空表格单元承接配方与规格主张，数值全部留白由后期合成。
shots.textZone: two stacked section title slots with aligned blank parameter rows beneath each

shots.intent: 降低决策风险：用留空的喂食指引结构与猫期待进食的神态，把用法讲清而不编造数字。
shots.textZone: centred display headline slot at the top, two stacked empty guideline blocks with blank cells in the middle band

shots.intent: 让买家可选：同一视觉体系下的规格阵容陈列，解决选哪种与换口味 continuity 的疑问。
收口促单：以留空的行动按钮与复购主张收尾，把足量组合转化为下单动作。
shots.textZone: two stacked display headline slots in the upper half and one rounded button shape in the centre

style.backgroundSystem: seamless #FFFFFF for pack and lineup screens, pale marble #F1EAE0 and warm stone #E5D8C6 for benefit and texture screens, off-white paper panel #FCFAF6 for info screens, every text screen enclosed by one thin rounded gold rule #C9A227
style.direction: premium pet-nutrition ecommerce, warm festive gold accent system on bright neutral stone
style.iconSystem: thin double-arc badge outlines and single-weight line icons in #C9A227 only; badges stay empty frames until real copy is composited in post
style.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio light, large front-left key with a soft fill card, soft contact shadows that always touch the ground plane; skimming side light only on texture close-ups; no harsh speculars, no rim-light glow
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium pet-nutrition ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white background #FFFFFF, pale marble surface #F1EAE0, one warm gold accent #C9A227 and deep charcoal type #2F2E33; warm high-key colour temperature throughout; bright even studio lighting with a large front-left key, soft fill and true soft contact shadows; one modern geometric sans-serif family only, letterspaced caps for small labels, no script and no mixed fonts; thin double-arc gold badge outlines kept as empty frames; clean high-end pet food photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable can silhouette, lid ring and label placement, pack rows staggered by height, generic unidentifiable domestic cat; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no mixed fonts or handwritten headline
no random backgrounds outside the stone and paper system
no filled badges, shields or real certification marks
no redesign or relabel of the product
style.presentationRules: keep the can silhouette, lid ring and label placement identical across every screen; pack rows always staggered by height with the tallest item at the back; the pet reads as a generic domestic cat with an unidentifiable face; product never obscured by props, bowl or fur
style.surfaceSystem: pale marble #F1EAE0, warm stone #E5D8C6 and matte off-white paper panel #FCFAF6, always clean and lightly reflective
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family only; display headline and small labels use the same family at different weights, letterspaced caps for labels, no script, no handwritten, no serif mixing
